title: PSP Dispute Reason Crosswalk
description: Dispute reason-code crosswalk across PayPal, Stripe, Adyen and Square (PSP-DISPUTE-CROSSWALK-NODE-1, hub proposal PAYPAL-HUB-PROPOSALS-2026-10-24 §10.3(2) as narrowed by the desk 2026-10-25: static and credential-free). From one PSP's own dispute-reason value in that PSP's exact enum spelling, or from a card-network reason code where the snapshots publish a mapping (Visa, Mastercard), the node returns the equivalent reason values at the other three PSPs with a per-cell match grade (exact / partial / none), each cell justified by the snapshot clause ids and verbatim quotes that support it, plus the evidence categories per PSP where a snapshot states them, the network codes where any snapshot states a mapping, the concept and per-PSP match. A mapping no snapshot supports is none, never inferred; snapshot-stated absences are cited as stated. Unknown PSP, unknown reason, non-string reason, both-or-neither input shape and unknown network or network code are refused by name. Clause authority: research/clause-snapshots/{paypal,stripe,adyen,square}-disputes-2026-10/SNAPSHOT.md (row PSP-DISPUTES-PRIMARY-TEXT-1). Zero network, zero PII, synthetic values only.

input_schema.description: Exactly one of two input shapes: {psp, reason} (a PSP concept lookup) or {network_code: {network, code}} (a card-network reason-code lookup). Supplying both shapes, or neither, is refused with REFUSED_INPUT_SHAPE; an empty object hits the categorical psp check first and is refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_PSP (recorded nuance, asserted by fixtures).

psp.description: The PSP whose dispute-reason vocabulary the input value belongs to. Any other value is refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_PSP. Read unconditionally by compute().

reason.description: One dispute-reason value in the given PSP's own exact enum spelling: PayPal dispute_reason schema v1.12 (including the British UNAUTHORISED; the American UNAUTHORIZED is refused), Stripe reason, Adyen Visa scheme reason code (e.g. 10.4), or Square DisputeReason. A value no snapshot table carries is refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_REASON; a non-string reason is refused by the same name, never a crash.

network_code.description: Card-network reason-code lookup, alternative to {psp, reason}.

network.description: Card network whose dispute reason-code table the snapshots reproduce. Other networks are refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_NETWORK.

code.description: Network reason code as published (Visa 13.1-style; Mastercard 4855-style). A code the snapshot table does not carry is refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_NETWORK_CODE.

mcp_tool_definition.name: crosswalk_psp_dispute_reasons
mcp_tool_definition.description: Crosswalk a dispute reason across PayPal, Stripe, Adyen and Square: from one PSP's own reason value (or a Visa/Mastercard reason code), return the equivalents at the other three with per-cell match grades and the snapshot clause citations that justify each cell; unsupported mappings are none, never inferred. Deterministic, offline, zero PII.

psp.description: PSP whose vocabulary the reason value belongs to.

reason.description: Dispute-reason value in that PSP's exact enum spelling.

network_code.description: {network: visa|mastercard, code} card-network reason-code lookup, alternative to psp+reason.

output_schema.description: output_payload: input echo, concept + concept_label, match, per_psp_match, crosswalk {<psp>: {psp, value, match, basis, evidence_categories, clauses [{id, quote, url}]}}, network_codes, network_codes_note, cited_clauses [{id, quote, url}], domain_errors [{code}], refusal_reason.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. The two shapes ({psp, reason} and {network_code}) are the kernel's own exactly-one-of contract; reason vocabularies are reproduced verbatim from the four primary-text snapshots (PayPal S5 schema v1.12, Stripe S2/S5, Adyen A4 Visa table, Square Q4), network tables from Stripe S5 (Visa, Mastercard).
author: PostOakLabs
